findings.text: follow-on: the new border test compares _dilate4 against an independent reference and reddens on a wrapping mutation, but restoring the deleted wall_mask._dilate4_np duplicate leaves it green because both implementations agree in bounds, so nothing asserts the deduplication the node's goal names.

follow-on: after_suite records revision e7bd253326fbc986dc1fdd8cfac4d894ef5e92b0 while the reviewed head is 273e4dc6b91651903ee2da871df2a674dbc842f8; the intervening commit touches only the restored carrier closure and the evidence fragment and none of the five measured test files, so the 36-to-34 delta stands but the arm is one commit behind the head.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against 63caf693; 6d00aabf6 consolidates the dilation and the helpers, e7bd25332 deletes the carrier tooling, 20bdab4be records the evidence fragment, and 273e4dc6b restores the carrier dependency closure a tracked test imports, all inside scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: item (1) is met (dilation-base.log records 100 random-mask equalities at the base revision and the new border test at tests/test_equilibrium_forward_solve.py:147 passes); item (2)'s specified docs census found zero names for each benchmark, yet a live tracked test importer overrode deletion and is recorded in the evidence; item (3) is met (helpers centralized, source-text assertions about fixed_point.py deleted with the reason stated); the five-file gate records 36 base to 34 edited failure IDs with zero added.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal removes a duplicated dilation, dead carrier benchmarks and copied test helpers; nova/equilibrium/morphology.py:7 is now the single dilation owner called by nova/equilibrium/wall_mask.py:391, benchmarks/carrier_advance_diagnosis.py and benchmarks/h200_matrix_benchmark.py are deleted, and tests/conftest.py:19 holds the one _green_block and _solovev definition each, so the goal is met while two benchmarks a live test imports are deliberately kept.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, four commits, the negative-control log path, baseline_suite 36 failure IDs and after_suite 34, and the receipt and carrier head results 15/15 and 5/5.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's sixteen declared paths; git diff 63caf693143b26d2a689939bb9073b5f969d2b75..273e4dc6b91651903ee2da871df2a674dbc842f8 touches only those paths, including the four carrier files the repair commit restores byte-identical to the base blobs.

justifications.durability: tests/test_equilibrium_forward_solve.py:147 asserts against an independent in-bounds reference loop and reddens on the edge-propagating mutation at dilation-negative-control.log, but it would not redden if the deleted NumPy duplicate were restored, so it guards border semantics rather than the consolidation.
justifications.evidence: the delta is recorded and verified at baseline-suite.log 36 and after-suite.log 34 with the two absent IDs a strict subset of the base set, but after_suite names revision e7bd25332 while the reviewed head is 273e4dc6b, and the "identical results" claim rests on a probe log rather than the committed assertion.
justifications.fit: nova/equilibrium/morphology.py:7 follows the module's one-expression idiom and every added or moved name (morphology._dilate4, tests/conftest.py:_green_block, tests/conftest.py:_solovev) is descriptive with no plan, version or ticket label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: nova/equilibrium/morphology.py:7 owns the one dilation, the two genuinely dead benchmark drivers are deleted, and tests/conftest.py:19 owns the shared helpers, though the coefficient carrier module survives as a live test's dependency rather than being removed.
justifications.reuse: the change merges two dilation definitions into one owner at nova/equilibrium/morphology.py:7 and five copied test helpers into two definitions at tests/conftest.py:19, forking nothing; a repository search found no other owned dilation in source.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in git diff 63caf693143b26d2a689939bb9073b5f969d2b75..273e4dc6b91651903ee2da871df2a674dbc842f8 is inside the manifest's declared write paths, and no nova/equilibrium source is edited outside morphology.py and wall_mask.py.
